# On-call handbook

## How the rotation works

The on-call engineer keeps the shared calendar current and hands over at nine every Monday.

Handover notes list open incidents, flaky alerts and anything that changed during the week.

Every alert links to a runbook; an alert without a runbook is a bug against the owning team.

Severity one pages the whole rotation, severity two pages the primary only, severity three waits for the morning.

Status updates go to the incident channel every thirty minutes until the incident is closed.

Postmortems are blameless and are due within five working days of the incident.

Customer communication is owned by support, and engineers only supply the facts.

Pager volume above five per shift is treated as a reliability problem for the next sprint.

Escalation to the database team happens after 20 minutes of read-only mode on the primary replica.
